name: Kocurypelta
isnote: A paratypothoracin aetosaur (English Wikipedia); the atlas parent is Typothoracinae.
sum: Kocurypelta is a paratypothoracin aetosaur from the Norian Lissauer Breccia of southern Poland.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
